quests.title: Short Delivery, Macquarie Fields
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The Macquarie Fields order has been two cartons light every week since the week of the show and the invoice says otherwise every time. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Macquarie Fields
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $69 owing to Macquarie Fields and it is not going to walk in here itself. You will see what I mean the second you get there. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: $69, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Macquarie Fields Run
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. I do the Macquarie Fields run at the second express and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Ingleburn
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Macquarie Fields
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. I have got a folding table in the back of the van and the Macquarie Fields shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Macquarie Fields
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Three of the Macquarie Fields regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $67 down on those days. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$67, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Macquarie Fields
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Everything Macquarie Fields sells comes off a floor at Ingleburn, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us

quests.title: Under 12s at Hornsby
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. I have got eleven kids for a twelve-a-side at Hornsby on school holidays and one of them has a note from his mother. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the estate behind the ground, ask around
the noticeboard where the sign-on sheet went up
any kid with boots will do at this point

quests.title: Registration, Hornsby
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. We found a twelfth, which means the Hornsby club now owes the association $67 it had budgeted on not owing. You will see what I mean the second you get there. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: $67 before the cut-off
I will drive it in myself

quests.title: The Hornsby Canteen
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. The canteen at Hornsby does two hundred sausages on a Saturday and this week the freezer went off at five in the morning. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: we are going to need the coffee
the thermometer, so the insurance believes us

quests.title: Grand Final Float, Hornsby
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Somebody walked off with the float from the Hornsby canteen at about five in the morning during the last home game, and I have a fair idea which somebody. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the pair who were leaning on the roller door
$81, which is what was in the tin

quests.title: Sprinkler Line, Hornsby
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The sprinkler line under the Hornsby outfield has been leaking since school holidays and the wet patch has started to move. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: walk the line from the tap to the boundary
where the grass has gone dark
I want to dig once, not five times

quests.title: The Association, Hornsby
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. The bloke who allocates grounds for the whole association sits at Waitara, and Hornsby has been at the bottom of his list for two seasons. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: go and be reasonable at him
tell me if it is us or the paperwork

quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Somebody has been tipping fill into the creek behind Woonona since a public holiday nobody remembered and it is narrowing the channel a metre at a time. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. If anyone asks, you were never here.

the council reads photographs, not letters

quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. They have agreed to a clean-up at Woonona, which is wonderful, except the grant is $55 short and closes on a public holiday nobody remembered. You will see what I mean the second you get there. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

quests.title: Sandbags, Woonona
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. We had 68 sandbags in the Woonona shed on a public holiday nobody remembered and this morning we have got the pallet they came on. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I'll see you right for it.

anywhere they have obviously been used
